# em dash

<!-- ❌ trigger on the use of em dash without a space before and after -->
Most newspapers—and all that follow AP style—insert a space before and after the em dash.

<!-- ✅ ignore when em dashes are used as placeholders -->
Was ne⁠——⁠y going to m⁠—— K⁠——, but now ——⁠t.
The juvenile defendant, ———, was arraigned yesterday.

<!-- ✅ ignore the use of em dash with a space before and after -->
Alterations — if needed — are accepted.
